usage: Persist this file inside your repositories as .codescene/code-health-rules.json. Rule sets are evaluated top to bottom and only the first match applies; anything not matched uses CodeScene's defaults.

rule_sets.matching_content_path_doc: Alembic migrations: generated, append-only and never refactored once applied, so size and duplication say nothing about maintainability.

rules.name: Lines of Code in a Single File

rule_sets.matching_content_path_doc: Backend tests (pytest): explicit, repetitive arrange/assert blocks are preferred over clever helpers, so test smells count at half weight instead of being ignored.
Frontend tests (vitest/jest, co-located as *.test.ts/tsx): describe/it callbacks are large anonymous functions by design, so the same half weights as backend tests.
